items.description: PM નરેન્દ્ર મોદીએ કહ્યું કે નક્સલી હિંસાથી સૌથી વધુ નુકસાન જનજાતીય સમાજને થયું. 2014માં દેશના લગભગ 125 જિલ્લાઓ માઓવાદી અને નક્સલી હિંસાથી પ્રભાવિત હતા. દર વર્ષે હજારો લોકો અને આદિવાસીઓના જીવ જતા હતા. તેમણે આરોપ લગાવ્યો કે અગાઉની સરકારોએ આ સમસ્યા પર ધ્યાન આપ્યું નહીં. નક્સલીઓ ગરીબ પરિવારોનાં બાળકો અને દીકરીઓને ઉઠાવી જતા હતા. અમે નક્સલવાદ-માઓવાદનો અંત લાવ્યો. તેના કારણે હવે આદિવાસી મહિલાઓ અને પરિવારોમાં સુરક્ષાનો વિશ્વાસ વધ્યો છે. પીએમ રવિવારે મહારાષ્ટ્રના ગઢચિરોલીમાં આયોજિત કાર્યક્રમમાં વર્ચ્યુઅ…

items.title: Mystery bronze leg in Scottish bog linked to giant Roman emperor statue
items.author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
items.description: Emperor Antoninus Pius, celebrated for his peace-driven rule and military expeditions, may have a newly discovered connection to history. A bronze leg unearthed in Scotland suggests a statue that honored him was disassembled by Roman forces prior to their withdrawal in AD 161, challenging prior beliefs of theft. This discovery sheds light on how Rome strategically managed its monuments, and further archaeological investigations could reveal more insights.

items.author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
items.description: Cristiano Ronaldo expanded his Pestana CR7 hotel empire with a planned €60 million project in Paris, which was expected to open in 2027. items.title: Travis Kelce-backed Six Flags faces $5 billion debt crisis amid park sale fears
items.author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
items.description: Travis Kelce-backed Six Flags is facing mounting financial pressure, with nearly $5 billion in debt raising questions about its future. The amusement park giant is considering further asset sales after selling seven regional parks for $331.4 million. Industry analysts have raised the possibility of flagship destinations such as Cedar Point and Kings Island being sold, although Six Flags has not confirmed any specific sale plans.

items.title: Meet the hooded pitohui, a poisonous bird whose touch can cause numbness
items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: The hooded pitohui, distinguished by its vibrant plumage, is the sole avian species known to harbor neurotoxins. These harmful compounds can inflict symptoms like irritation and numbness if applied to human skin. Studies suggest that these toxins are derived from its diet, especially from consuming specific beetles. Another species, the blue-capped ifrita, also possesses similar toxic traits. Caution is advised for birdwatchers in areas where these unique birds are found.

items.title: 10-year-old calls 911 after dad suffers stroke behind wheel, helps save him
items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: During a road trip to Georgia, Taylor Fritts showcased incredible presence of mind when his father suffered a stroke. While driving in Sweetwater, Tennessee, he observed his father's peculiar speech and actions. Without hesitation, Taylor contacted emergency services, leading to a swift hospital transfer via helicopter. His bravery earned him recognition as a 'Stroke Champion', highlighting the unbreakable bond between father and son.

items.title: Tiny bushland patches offer lifeline to endangered Australian cockatoos
items.author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
items.description: Urbanization is significantly impacting the habitats of Carnaby's cockatoos in Western Australia. Research indicates that these birds are forced to travel longer distances in search of food across divided landscapes. Even minor patches of native vegetation play a vital role as connections between larger habitats. It's essential for conservation initiatives to prioritize these smaller areas to safeguard wildlife.

items.title: DNA test helps 81-year-old find Canadian soldier father and half-sister
items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: After 81 years of searching for answers about his father, Rod Anderson finally uncovered his family's history thanks to a DNA test. His father, Charles Blakney, served in the Canadian military during World War II in England. Blakney's granddaughter, Bethany Allen, took on the mystery and connected with Anderson, highlighting how wartime bonds can profoundly influence family dynamics. This newfound connection has brought Anderson much-needed closure.
